stories.title: Silksong Release Date Announced by Team Cherry
stories.summary: Team Cherry has announced that Silksong launches worldwide on September 20 2026 for PC and all major consoles.
stories.why_it_matters: One of the most anticipated games of the year finally has a launch date.
